title: Retrospective Hyperliquid market-state source transfer
claim: The frozen Binance market-state model may retain descriptive 15-minute forecast-loss improvement when applied without tuning to an existing Hyperliquid period.
mechanism: Normalized return, range, activity, and basket-state relationships may transfer across liquid perpetual venues, but venue microstructure and volume scales may prevent transfer.
target: Fifteen-minute outright Hyperliquid perpetual log return in a point-in-time basket four.
informationSet: Official Hyperliquid historical candles and point-in-time universe snapshots already existing at task start
primaryBaseline: Frozen Binance model's strongest aligned baseline

evidence.summary: Across 18,871 rows and 16.53 observed calendar days, the frozen Binance model had -0.0713% relative MSE improvement versus the strongest market-only baseline; descriptive HAC p=0.72. BTC was positive while ETH, HYPE, and SOL were negative. Rolling REST retention shortened the requested August period, and no promotion is permitted.

nextAction: Preserve the negative transfer evidence and do not tune around it. Any revisit requires a materially distinct venue-normalized mechanism and a fresh candidate ID.
